segments.name: Natural gas vehicle fuel
segments.description: Supplies RNG and conventional natural gas as CNG and LNG vehicle fuel, plus related services and environmental credits, to fleet operators in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Fleet customers pay for CNG and LNG vehicle fuel through contracts or per fill-up, obligated parties buy Environmental Credits, and station customers pay fixed or per-use fees for O&M services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our CNG vehicle fuel sales are primarily made through contracts with our customers or on a per fill-up basis at prices we set at public access fueling stations based on prevailing market conditions.
